notes: The interview loop is now a data engineering staff loop: nine rounds, with a card showing the typical loop at Meta, Google, Uber and Salesforce.
New SQL round: Hard problems against a 15-minute clock (shown on the problem page), with your best time per problem, and the eight SQL patterns most live rounds use.
New data modelling round: model a product (Uber trips, Meta ads, a Salesforce pipeline, orders, music plays) part by part, then compare with the model answer and tick the rubric.
New product sense and metrics round (Meta style): goal, metrics with a guardrail, events to log, pipeline, the metric in SQL, and diagnosing a drop.

System design now uses data platforms at real scale: 1 million events a second exactly once, multi-region CDC, a multi-petabyte backfill, a feature store and a lakehouse migration, each with its module, simulator challenges and an estimate. The web designs are still there, folded.
